infinite_meaning: extendable, repeatable human-approved research cycles, not infinite compute or guaranteed cures

agents.task: topic intake and bounded source selection
hash each evidence record and preserve source IDs
search for metadata gaps, retractions and counterevidence
require qualified human review before biomedical claims
coordinate bounded results without launching background agents

guardrails: A trial registration does not prove benefit or safety
An abstract cannot substitute for critical appraisal of the full study
A reported result or literature record is not a treatment recommendation
Never declare that an intervention cures cancer based on metadata
Source citations are unverified until examined by a qualified researcher
Patient identifiers, biometrics and medical records are not accepted
No access keys, shell execution, lab automation, patient interventions, or autonomous clinical trials
No automatic GitHub scheduling; manual trigger only with time and result caps
